propositions: Introduce `.bridge_state/get_rotation.json` as a dedicated rotation state sidecar while dual-writing the legacy inline field during the rollout window to ensure interleaved old and new binary compatibility.
Read and persist rotation state using `max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value)` per Jira key, with fail-open load/save and dual-write persistence through all `BindingStore.save()` paths.
An idempotent pass with no absent-key GETs on an initialized store leaves all committed bridge-state files byte-identical and does not advance HEAD.
A pass with at most 20 absent-key GETs advances the same selected Jira-key stamps in both `get_rotation.json` and the legacy inline fields, staged and committed together without `git add -A`.

Legacy-only binding stores migrate their inline rotation state to the sidecar on the next persisted save, and `reconcile-check` against pre-migration stores leaves git status clean without creating `get_rotation.json`.
`outbound_differ.py` remains at or below 800 lines after extracting existing outbound wrappers, and `GET_ROTATION_FILE` is documented in `_store/push.py` regenerable-files.
